x = a(t - sin t), y = a(1 - cos t) from t = 0 to t = p (see Figure 11.12).
Solution From Equation (3) in Section 11.1, we want to find the time
for ds and y expressed parametrically in terms of the parameter t. For the cycloid, dx>dt = a(1 - cos t) and dy>dt = a sin t, so
= 2a2 (1 - 2 cos t + cos2 t + sin2 t) dt
Substituting for ds and y in the integrand, it follows that
a2(2 - 2 cos t) 2ga (1 - cos t) dt y = a(1 - cos t)

Specifically, we found that the surface area is S = 12py ds for revolution about the x-axis, and S = 12px ds for revolution about the y-axis.
